# cloudendure Provider

!> **Deprecated:** The CloudEndure provider is deprecated and no longer maintained. AWS has discontinued CloudEndure Disaster Recovery; migrate to AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS).

Manages CloudEndure Disaster Recovery / Migration resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cloudendure = {
      source = "boris-yakimov/cloudendure"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are best supplied through the environment:
#   export CLOUDENDURE_API_KEY="..."
#   export CLOUDENDURE_PROJECT_ID="..."
provider "cloudendure" {
  # api_key    = var.cloudendure_api_key
  # project_id = var.cloudendure_project_id
  # api_url    = "https://console.cloudendure.com/api/latest"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) CloudEndure user API token. Can also be set with the `CLOUDENDURE_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `api_url` (String) CloudEndure API base URL. Defaults to `https://console.cloudendure.com/api/latest`. Can also be set with the `CLOUDENDURE_API_URL` environment variable.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the CloudEndure project to manage. Can also be set with the `CLOUDENDURE_PROJECT_ID` environment variable.
